metrics.name: 30-Year US Treasury Yield
metrics.description: Added 2026-W34. The long end became a direct transmission channel into AI capex this week: the Aug 18 AI-infra selloff had no AI-demand news in it, only a 30Y print and an off-balance-sheet accounting story. Contingent, long-dated, levered AI commitments are duration exposure, so this is the rate that reprices them.

series.note: intraday high, highest since ~2007; closed ~5.29%. A 30Y auction earlier in the month cleared at 5.216%, highest since 2001. 10Y 4.70%, easing to 4.65% Aug 19 on a Treasury long-bond buyback announcement.
